corrections.reason: Completes the vocative 'እግዚኦ' (Lord!) split from the end of the previous page ('እግዚ-ኦ'); the 7th-order vowel tilt on 'ኦ' is visible in the scan.
The canonical Ge'ez phrase from Luke 13:19 referenced here is 'ኅጠተ ሰናፔ' (a grain of mustard seed); the three-legged 'ጠ' with faded middle leg was misread as 'ወ'.
Standard Amharic copula 'ናቸው' (they are); uneven ink on the right loop of 'ው' made it resemble 'ዋ'.
